text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, you can do it! Chrono-chan, win this...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Chrono!
Just a little more... Just a bit further!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I can hear them... cheering for me.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Just like me at last year's Takarazuka Kinen...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's SchÃ¶n Lilie!
SchÃ¶n Lilie pulls further away!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, keep going... Just a little more...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gh... Ms. Lilieeeeeeeee!
Go get 'eeeeeeeeeemmm!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to answer... those cheers!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To live up to your feelings, you who dared to dream in me!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: May the blissful ecstasy that fills me be granted to you as well!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
1st place, Chrono Genesis!
A Tiara Umamusume proves her dominance once again this year!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(1st place... Did I...
properly live up to expectations...?)

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, YESSS!
Chrono-chan took 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Chrono's incredible!
She looks so insanely cool when she runs!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously way too strong!
Ah, that was an awesome run to watch!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fans
text_block_list.text: S-So cute...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, you were so strong!
Chrono!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd close the gap of a full year's advantage...
I'm thoroughly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still...
that means there's no impossibility that can't be overturned, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis was amazing!
With powerful running like that, I can't wait to see what she does next!"

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
This result was seized by your love for racing!
Congratulations, Chrono Genesis!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Ouah, are all these cheers for her?
That's incredible!"
choice_data_list: Today's victory will win you even more fans!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...You, take a video. Record the crowd's voices.
These cheers are invaluable historical records marking her journey.

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text: D'accord, let's record it right away!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Chrono, that was a great run! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone...
Thank you so much for cheering for me...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I... as a fan of Twinkle Series racing,
have watched... the Grand Prix races up until now.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So... being chosen by the fan vote
and getting to race... um, err...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Go for it—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
I can't quite put how I feel into words right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm so... happy!
Thank you so much for this moment...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When I saw everyone's faces in the stands...
my heart just became so full...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The words I prepared can't express it... But... I just can't find the right way to say it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I'm a failure of a writer...
choice_data_list: No, I definitely felt the sentiment behind it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Looking at that scenery from the Winner's Circle...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It really sank in... that I have become a part of racing history, too...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Everyone was looking at me
with sparkling eyes, full of expectation...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Just like... the me of the past,
who watched from the grandstands..."
choice_data_list: I think you managed to run in a way that really moved people, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
But... even more, so much more.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: With my running... I want to create the kind of emotion... that will be passed down as a legendary race...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Besides... if I am to run... I want to show my respect for racing history as well...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I wish to walk the same path that so many seniors have walked.
I want to continue on the royal road for my next race as well, but...
choice_data_list: Then... the Tenno Sho (Autumn) it is.
Then... the Tenno Sho (Autumn) it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
A race steeped in tradition and prestige, indispensable when discussing Japanese racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I will leave behind the hoofprints that only I can carve...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen—that was a tough, splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Between Lilie-san and others, Umamusume who follow the Tiara route have been remarkably resilient lately, haven't they~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even though people said it would be
difficult for a Tiara Umamusume to win a Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...And the ones who completely shattered those expectations were
Sweep Tosho-san in the Takarazuka Kinen
and Daiwa Scarlet-san in the Arima Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "I-I was glued to the screen cheering, too...! It's one of my favorite races...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you've carved your own hoofprints there too, haven't you, Chrono-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
I-I'm truly honored...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And that... is all thanks to the strength
given to me by the fans' cheers...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fans are... an essential part
of Umamusume racing history――

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Together with all the fans who love racing...
I'll aim for consecutive Grand Prix victories...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Do your best.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Umamusume and their fans.
Indispensable parts of building racing history...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There is... one more precious thing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If we can get by without anyone noticing,
that would be for the best, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...
I looked over the summer training camp plan...
choice_data_list: How was it from a Genesis Method standpoint?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...B-barring any irregularities,
I believe we can expect great results this autumn...!
choice_data_list: Alright! Let's make this summer count too!
Okay! Let's do our best this summer too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... I shall go to carve my name in history at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as well...!
